sources.title: openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Whisper large-v3-turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large-v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4.
